lead: Resizable panels: panels side by side (or stacked), with drag bars between them that can be dragged, or focused and adjusted with the arrow keys and Home / End. Each panel can have a minimum / maximum size, in pixels or percentages, and the last panel absorbs changes in the container's size.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `splitter.css`. Splitter fills its parent, so the parent needs a height (when horizontal).
styling.splitter: The whole (flex); `data-orientation` / `data-ready` (once the container size is measured) / `data-dragging` / `data-disabled`
styling.panel: Each panel; its `--splitter-size` is the size in pixels, and the last panel (`data-last`) absorbs the remaining space
styling.bar: The drag bar (zero width) and the absolutely positioned drag area inside it (`role=separator`, focusable, `data-active` while dragging); the line and the grip are its pseudo-elements
